title: Cover — Mentor Magic Spring 2026
text: Mentor Magic. Spring 2026. Connecting students with mentors who inspire.
captions: A warm photograph of two people in conversation at a café table, with sunlight streaming through the window. The title 'Mentor Magic' appears in bold lettering at the top.

title: Page 2 — Table of Contents
text: In this issue: A note from the director (page 3). Meet our mentors (pages 4–7). Student spotlight (pages 8–11). Program highlights (pages 12–14). How to get involved (page 15).
captions: Clean layout with page numbers and section headings listed vertically. A small decorative illustration of a plant in the lower left corner.

title: Page 3 — Director's Note
text: Welcome to the spring issue of Mentor Magic. This semester has been one of our most impactful yet, with over 200 mentor–mentee pairs building meaningful relationships across the program. We hope these stories inspire you as much as they inspire us.
captions: Headshot of the program director with a short biography. Their signature appears below the note.

title: Page 4 — Meet Our Mentors
text: This semester we welcomed 24 new mentors from a variety of industries including technology, healthcare, education, and the arts.
captions: A grid of six circular portrait photos, each labeled with the mentor's name and industry. The layout is clean with generous spacing.

title: Page 5 — Mentor Spotlight: Maria Chen
text: Maria Chen has been a mentor with our program for three years. A software engineer by day, she volunteers her weekends to help students explore careers in technology. 'What I get out of mentorship is just as valuable as what I give,' she says.
captions: Full-width photo of Maria working at a laptop in a bright office. A pull-quote is displayed in large type over the image.

title: Page 15 — How to Get Involved
text: Interested in becoming a mentor? Visit our website or speak with a program coordinator. Applications open each August and January.
captions: Infographic showing three steps to becoming a mentor: Apply online, attend orientation, and meet your mentee.

title: Page 16 — Back Cover
text: Mentor Magic is produced by the Campus Mentorship Office. For more information, visit our website.
captions: Back cover with program logo, contact information, and social media handles.
